# Lab 22.6: Create a Custom SHA Module

## What We Are Going to Do
Write a custom Security Health Analytics module that flags any VM with an external IP, and see its findings in Security Command Center.

## Steps

1. **Check the tier.** Custom modules need SCC **Premium** or **Enterprise**, and the **Security Center Admin Editor** role.

2. **Write the module.** Create `vm-external-ip.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">severity: HIGH
description: "This VM has an external IP address."
recommendation: "Remove the external IP. Use IAP for admin access and Cloud NAT for outbound traffic."
resource_selector:
  resource_types:
  - compute.googleapis.com/Instance
predicate:
  expression: resource.networkInterfaces.exists(n, has(n.accessConfigs) &amp;&amp; n.accessConfigs.size() &gt; 0)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create it at organization level.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc custom-modules sha create \
  --organization=ORG_ID \
  --display-name="vm_external_ip" \
  --enablement-state="ENABLED" \
  --custom-config-from-file=vm-external-ip.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a VM that breaks the rule.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create public-ip-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Wait for the scan.** Custom modules run in batch scans, so findings can take several hours. Then open **Security Command Center → Findings** and filter **Category** = `VM_EXTERNAL_IP`.

6. **Read the finding.** It shows your description, recommendation and severity, like a built-in finding.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete public-ip-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud scc custom-modules sha list --organization=ORG_ID
gcloud scc custom-modules sha delete MODULE_ID --organization=ORG_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Module logic | A CEL expression on resource properties |
| Finding category | The module's display name in capitals |
| Timing | Batch scans, not real time |
| Tier | Premium or Enterprise |
